title: eriogonum umbellatum var. covillei
intro: Eriogonum umbellatum var. covillei, commonly known as Coville's Buckwheat Cliff Maiden's Hair, is a variety of flowering plant in the buckwheat family (Polygonaceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, supporting digestive health, and aiding in the treatment of wounds and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Eriogonum umbellatum var. covillei include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
